lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho2CuBiO6 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/amd (No. 143), with a 20-atom unit cell and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and Bi each coordinated by six O neighbors in octahedral motifs, while Ho adopts a 12-vertex close-packed-like arrangement. Corner-sharing occurs between CuO6 and BiO6 octahedra, and face-sharing between Ho and both Cu and Bi polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional periodic connectivity network.
